dz: 马克·安东尼在亚历山德里亚战役中赢得了对屋大维的最后一场骑兵战役,但他的步兵被击败,第二天他所率领的舰队和部队开始向屋大维出逃.
de: Mark Antony wins a final cavalry battle against Octavian in the battle of Alexandria, but his infantry is defeated and the next day his fleet and troops start to desert to Octavian.

dz: 屋大维(后被称作奥古斯都)进入埃及亚历山大,处决了马库斯·安东尼乌斯·安蒂卢斯,将这座城市由罗马共和国控制. (日期为O.S.)
de: Octavian (later known as Augustus) enters Alexandria, Egypt, executes Marcus Antonius Antyllus, and brings the city under the control of the Roman Republic. (date is O.S.)
